name: graphql-authz
description:
GraphQL Authorization validates access to GraphQL query and mutation root fields based on 
JWT claims or OAuth scopes provided by an upstream authentication policy such as jwt-auth.

Rules are configured per field under queries/mutations (op-level), a type-wide wildcard, and a 
cross-type global fallback; every rule that matches a field applies together, so a wildcard or global 
rule is not skipped just because the field also has its own exact rule. A field matched by no rule at 
all is not governed by this policy instance and passes through. Every root field selected by a 
request is authorized independently, so a single request selecting multiple fields must satisfy every 
rule for every governed field.
